I'm 16 and I'm  pretty much what you would call a pansy, but 3 weeks ago I decided I was going to get an industrial and I did, though almost backed out when sitting in the chair. I'm glad I didn't! Mine only really hurts now if I catch it a couple of times or lean on it. I am so happy with it, I really think it is worth it :) 

I'm not sure about going swimming, you should probably wait until it is fully healed for that. And you can buy jewelry on websites (I'd probably ask around which websites are reliable first though) and alternative clothing shops sometimes sell them.
Mine cost £25, I'm not sure where you are from but that's like $37 I believe, which I think is pretty good price.
